items.title: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
items.summary: TARSphere is a robot framework that integrates physics simulation, embodied NPCs, and a frozen multimodal language model to evaluate long-horizon embodied agents across diverse indoor tasks and social conditions.

items.title: The LLM-Attacker: A Unified Red-Team Framework for Privacy Evaluation of Split and Distributed LLM Systems
items.summary: LLM-Attacker standardizes privacy evaluations for split language models by recording attacker configurations, enabling comparable scoring of reconstruction attacks, and requiring linked undefended baselines for defense claims.

items.title: EvalResearchBench: Can AI Agents Build Their Own Feedback for Recursive Self-Improvement?
items.summary: AI agents can automate benchmark design to reduce evaluation costs, but their generated evaluators still fall short of target agreement and suffer from budget exhaustion and score dominance issues.

items.title: Diffusion Language Models Change Speed Across Tasks and Languages
items.summary: Diffusion language models spend more computation on novel, rare, or incorrect outputs, and decoding speed can improve inference efficiency and reliability.

items.title: Different Tasks, Different Timesteps: Temporal Task-Aware Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: T2Quant improves diffusion language model quantization by dynamically allocating activation precision across denoising steps based on predicted task- and time-dependent sensitivity.

items.title: Bridging Exploration and Persona: Information-Directed Dueling for Test-Time Agent Personalization
items.summary: ID-TAP uses a neural dueling-bandit framework with similarity-weighted warm starts to adapt LLM agents to user preferences via binary response comparisons within a limited interaction budget.

items.title: IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: IF-MAP identifies high-impact agents in multi-agent LLM systems via prompt perturbation analysis to maximize system-level gains from targeted improvements.

items.title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
items.summary: LLM agents frequently leak sensitive conclusions assembled from multiple confidential documents, and common safeguards fail to eliminate this mosaic-style disclosure risk.

items.title: HyperDrone: Simulation-to-Reality Transfer at Millions of Frames per Second
items.summary: HyperDrone is a GPU-accelerated quadrotor simulator using a ray-tracing engine to render high-fidelity observations at high speed, enabling vision-based policy training and real-world transfer.

items.title: BrickWright: Agentic Creation of Physically Feasible Brick Builds
items.summary: BrickWright improves physical validity of AI-generated LEGO assemblies by providing agents with an assembly API and feasibility validator, achieving perfect validity while preserving prompt adherence.

items.title: Who Takes the Lead? Model Ability and Task-Conditioned Collaboration with Humans
items.summary: Researchers use a shared-control maze to show that stronger language-model agents selectively involve humans based on route advantage rather than failing to collaborate.

items.title: FilmFlow: Agentic System for 3D Virtual Film Cinematography
items.summary: FilmFlow is an agentic framework that translates natural-language or video instructions into executable camera trajectories for 3D scenes using specialized director, interpreter, scout, and critic agents, evaluated on the CinemaBench dataset.

items.title: RIDAR: Safeguarding Research Integrity in Autonomous Research Agents via Automated Detection and Runtime Intervention
items.summary: RIDAR detects and mitigates research integrity violations in autonomous agents via taxonomy-based post-hoc analysis and real-time intervention.

items.title: Realism VS Accuracy: Event Sequence Forecasting from a Generative Modeling Perspective
items.summary: Event sequence forecasting is evaluated as conditional generative modeling, revealing a trade-off between accuracy and realism, and a proposed algorithm converts realism into predictive accuracy.

items.title: MambaAct: Efficient Mamba Action Experts for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: MambaAct replaces the transformer action expert in flow-matching VLA policies with a compact Mamba-based expert and a context compressor to cut inference latency while improving robotic manipulation success.

items.title: SplatLab: Autonomous Scientific Discovery for 3DGS Research
items.summary: SplatLab autonomously reproduces 3D Gaussian Splatting baselines, proposes extensions, and writes manuscripts with fully traceable training logs, improving PSNR by up to 3.78 dB.

items.title: RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation
items.summary: RTAformer separately models persistent entities and changing relations in video scene graphs by injecting calibrated query differences and aligning cross-frame instances to overcome relational semantic inertia.

items.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
items.summary: IQuest-Q1 is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts foundation model trained via multi-stage pre-training, mid-training, and post-training to achieve strong agentic coding and general capabilities.

items.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
items.summary: WeVisOne-VL unifies object-level and pixel-level visual perception via structured token prediction, supporting detection, localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting with a lightweight pixel decoder and multi-stage training.

items.title: What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
items.summary: GAFU leverages native generation-side representations to improve fine-grained visual understanding in unified multimodal models by compressing them into compact tokens for task-conditioned retrieval.

items.title: What Makes a Good Unmasking Policy? A Controlled Study of Learned Unmasking in Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: Optimized unmasking policies for masked diffusion language models improve efficiency by using trajectory-contraction targets with confidence and hidden states, achieving better speed-accuracy trade-offs with minimal overhead.

items.title: RLSplat: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
items.summary: RLSplat enables feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting with linear reductions in latency, memory, and model size by allocating Gaussians regionally and decoding them via local attention.

items.title: TILDE: Teacher-in-the-Loop Distillation from Embodied Foundation Models
items.summary: TILDE distills embodied foundation model capabilities into robot policies via on-policy teacher supervision and autonomous recovery data collection, improving real-world task performance without large-scale action pretraining.

items.title: RouteWeaver: Weaving Mode Selection and Execution into Unified LLM Routing
items.summary: RouteWeaver unifies heterogeneous LLM routing modes via coordinated training and progressive exploration, improving accuracy across diverse reasoning tasks.

items.title: Heartbeat Thinking: Speculative Reasoning and Tool Execution While Listening in Realtime Voice Agents
items.summary: A heartbeat-style speculative reasoning approach lets voice agents continue preparing tool calls during speech updates, improving coverage and reducing response latency.

items.title: Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation
items.summary: LayerEditor unifies instruction-guided image editing with reusable RGBA layer generation via joint token modeling and edit-prior distillation, enabling precise local manipulation and layer reuse.

items.title: F2G-Pose: Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting for Direct RGB-D Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
items.summary: F2G-Pose is a real-time feed-forward framework that predicts category-level object pose, metric size, and completed shape from a single RGB-D image using dense visual features, DGCNN tokenization, and a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer.

items.title: Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models
items.summary: FRED improves single-step future video representations in world action models through self-distillation and temporal conditioning, boosting robot policy performance on long-horizon and unseen tasks.

items.title: AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark
items.summary: AnyGameRenderer is a video-to-video generative model that transforms low-quality agent-built game footage into high-fidelity visuals while preserving layout, camera, and entity timing.

items.title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
items.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operating conditions and potentially irreversible consequences. We position RSI within robot learning and trace pathways from improving robot capabilities to improving the processes that generate them. We examine how physical experience can strengthen these improvement mechanisms and when the resulting gains can support further self-improvement of the mechanisms themselves. Gains carry forward only when feedback addresses remaining learning needs, the receiving component can use the change, its value survives changes in tasks or hardware, and continued practice remains safe and affordable. Existing studies, concentrated in manipulation, support behavioral improvement, benefits to later learning, and procedure improvement. Some systems also change the improver's knowledge or tools, but the physical studies reviewed here have yet to isolate gains attributable to recursion. We synthesize these findings into evaluation principles and research directions for machines that, trial by trial, safely improve the way they improve.

items.title: MolLean: A Process-Verifiable Language for Chemical Reasoning
items.summary: MolLean introduces a verifiable chemical reasoning framework with explicit molecular states, Lean-based verification, and interactive tool feedback to reduce hallucinations across generation and reaction tasks.

items.title: SEAM: Spectral Embedding Alignment and Merging for Low-Resource TTS
items.summary: SEAM initializes unseen token embeddings from subtokens via spectral filtering and ridge regression, reducing training data needs by 75% for low-resource text-to-speech vocabulary expansion.

items.title: Verus-Insight: Towards Explainable Artifact Detection in AI-Generated Videos
items.summary: Verus-Insight improves AI-generated video detection by training artifact detectors through structured inspection planning, evidence verification, and evidence aggregation with human-anchored supervision.

items.title: Cola2: Co-Adaptive Hierarchical Language Modeling with Continuous Semantic Compression and Balanced Discrete Generation
items.summary: Cola2 improves hierarchical language generation by jointly optimizing continuous semantic compression, reconstruction-generation balance, and encoder-decoder co-adaptation via dynamic span segmentation, masked diffusion decoding, and flow-matching priors.

items.title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
items.summary: AgentVQA is an offline benchmark assessing vision-language models on realistic agentic tasks across web, robotics, video, games, and spatial planning, revealing that visual grounding and state tracking errors are the primary failure modes.

items.title: Deep Fusion Memory: A Chunk-Level Parametric Memory for Large Language Models
items.summary: Deep Fusion Memory integrates predicted parametric memory into intermediate hidden states via gated cross-attention, reducing retrieval overhead and improving knowledge-intensive tasks without online retrieval.

items.title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
items.summary: Reinforcement learning improves reasoning accuracy without requiring a specific wait marker, which originates from training data rather than RL, and automated evaluation metrics can misrepresent reasoning trends.

items.title: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
items.summary: OpenDS-World introduces a live-web benchmark to evaluate autonomous multi-step deep search agents, revealing significant gaps between frontier models and human performance.

items.title: Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression
items.summary: Test-time regression provides a learnable, closed-form alternative to pooling for compressing sequences in efficient language and multimodal models.

items.title: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought
items.summary: Raw retrieval-augmented generation over unprocessed conversation history outperforms complex agentic memory systems across multiple benchmarks, indicating that preserving raw evidence is more critical than elaborate memory transformations.

items.title: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
items.summary: SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into skeleton-guided kinematic and residual components to improve controllable robot world modeling and motion transfer.

items.title: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
items.summary: Policy-Mask learns a budget-conditioned selection policy over diffusion timesteps, network blocks, and channels to extract compact, task-optimal features for discriminative vision tasks.

items.title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
items.summary: Researchers introduce a benchmark and evaluation framework for video-centered deep research agents that synthesize external evidence into interactive reports linked to video moments.

items.title: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
items.summary: SCOPE compiles compound policies into optimized neural-symbolic programs that achieve high accuracy, stability, and interpretability on inexpensive models.

items.title: Foundation4D: Towards a unified perception and reconstruction model for autonomous vehicles
items.summary: Foundation4D is a unified feed-forward model that jointly estimates geometry, detects objects, predicts semantic occupancy, and reconstructs Gaussians from multi-camera driving video, achieving state-of-the-art results across several benchmarks.

items.title: LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
items.summary: LaLa-World is a language-conditioned latent world model that jointly learns from diverse simulation, robot, and video data to enable efficient model-predictive planning and policy initialization.

items.title: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
items.summary: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning enables video diffusion transformers to leverage multimodal language model representations for sparse temporal inference and factor-aware cinematic control through staged grounding and optimization.

items.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
items.summary: This survey unifies video understanding and generation through world modeling, organizing progress around inferring, synthesizing, sharing, and interacting with latent temporal states to emphasize persistent dynamics over clip-level perception.

items.title: Meta Expert: Cross-Layer Expert Sharing for Storage- and Retrieval-Efficient MoE
items.summary: Shared meta-experts across layers reduce redundancy and improve efficiency compared to layer-specific local experts in mixture-of-experts models.

items.title: Code2Video-Compass: A Comprehensive Benchmark for General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V
items.summary: Code2Video-Compass is a benchmark evaluating multimodal language models on code-based video generation across text, image, and video inputs, revealing significant challenges in complex dynamic and state-dependent tasks.
